capture_lane: SUPPORTED ATTENDED BROWSER (claude-in-chrome): navigate to BringFido's own Hotels property-type filter page (/lodging/hotels/city/<city>/ and ?page=N), then the page's own text (get_page_text). Nothing was solved or bypassed; no JavaScript was run on the page.
transcribed: Each card's NAME and the city BringFido prints under it, exactly as the page text gave them. BringFido's price, fee, weight and pet-count lines were read past and are NEVER recorded: competitor pet claims are not policy evidence.
